title: Sweet and Hearty Brazilian Chicken Fried Rice
description: A twist on traditional fried rice, this Brazilian-inspired dish features chicken and a sweet and savory sauce.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove chicken from skillet and set aside.
Add onion and bell pepper to skillet and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in soy sauce and sugar (if using).
Add cooked rice to skillet and stir-fry for about 2-3 minutes.
Return chicken to skillet and stir-fry until combined with rice.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
